info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking It Management Systems Assurance Review-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking IT Management Systems Assurance Review Submission API allows users to submit reviews for IT management systems assurance in the banking sector. This endpoint targets the evaluation of systems assurance by capturing essential insights and feedback based on predefined criteria. Typical consumers include financial institutions and IT auditors who aim to ensure compliance and enhance system integrity. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can streamline the review process and foster better governance across banking operations.
